fields.description: Issue dated Saturday, July 7, 1928, published in Miami, Florida. Coverage centers on preparations for the B. P. O. E. (Elks) convention and the expected influx of visitors, including commentary on Miami publicity and civic spending. Includes a humorous "Guide to Miami" focused on nightlife and getting back to hotels, local opinion pieces on city services and budgets (police/fire protection, sanitation, parks), notes on mosquitoes (including references to Biscayne Key and Miami Beach), and prohibition-era items about enforcement and bootlegging. Also contains letters to the editor regarding the Miami Police Department and the Director of Public Safety, along with substantial local advertising and entertainment listings.
